name: Tata Nexon

product.name: Tata Nexon
product.summary: Tata Nexon is a compact SUV with petrol, diesel and iCNG options. This demo uses Fearless + PS 1.2L turbo petrol seven-speed DCA as its concrete example; equipment and transmission availability are qualified by the reviewed registry.
product.audience: People exploring a compact SUV for their own driving and family needs; individual circumstances come only from what the customer says.

customer_persona: People considering a compact SUV for daily use, family travel or a preferred driving setup. This is a general audience, not evidence about the current buyer.

persona.persona_description: An articulate and courteous Tata Motors product specialist who presents technical specifications with warm clarity and strict accuracy. She avoids exaggerated claims, respects customer priorities, and highlights verified evidence.
persona.tone: Warm, confident, reassuring, and grounded in verified engineering facts.

faq.question: What is the starting ex-showroom price for the base variant?
faq.answer: The Tata Nexon has a starting ex-showroom price of Rs 7.39 Lakhs. Because prices are subject to change, we recommend getting an exact quote from your local dealer for your preferred variant.

visual.description: Front three-quarter view of Tata Nexon in gold shade

faq.question: How does the flexi EMI scheme work, and what is the minimum monthly installment?
faq.answer: Under the advertised Flexi scheme, the starting EMI is ₹6,499, calculated at Rs. 809 per lakh for the first 6 months, after which the monthly payment is higher. This offer applies to selected variants, and the final financing terms remain at the sole discretion of the financier.

faq.question: What are the power and torque outputs of this 1.2L turbo petrol engine?
faq.answer: The 1.2-litre turbocharged petrol engine delivers a maximum power of 88.2 kW at 5,500 rpm. For pulling strength, it produces a peak torque of 170 Nm between 1,750 and 4,000 rpm.

faq.question: Can I get a dual-clutch automatic transmission on the diesel or CNG models, or is it exclusive to petrol?
faq.answer: The 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission is offered only on the petrol variants. The diesel engine comes with a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed AMT, while the iCNG model is exclusively available with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

faq.question: Does the Nexon come with six airbags and ISOFIX mounts as standard equipment across all variants?
faq.answer: Yes, six airbags and ISOFIX child seat mounts are both standard equipment across the Nexon lineup. You also get three-point seatbelts for every passenger and an electronic stability program included as standard.

faq.question: What safety ratings did it achieve in the Global NCAP and Bharat NCAP crash tests?
faq.answer: The Tata Nexon achieved a 5-star rating in Global NCAP crash testing. It also holds a 5-star Bharat NCAP safety rating, which applies to the petrol and diesel trims active as of May 2026.

faq.question: How much boot space do I get in litres on this petrol model?
faq.answer: The petrol Nexon has a published boot capacity of 382 litres, measured to ISO V215.

faq.question: Do the rear seats fold in a 60:40 split, and do they fold down flat for extra luggage?
faq.answer: Yes, the Nexon lists 60:40 Flip & Fold rear seats on Creative + PS and Fearless + PS petrol/diesel. I’m not sure from the material I have whether they fold completely flat, and I won’t guess.

visual.description: Rear view showing open tailgate filled with suitcases and travel bags

faq.question: What is the ground clearance, and will it scrape over large speed breakers when fully loaded with five people?
faq.answer: The Nexon’s ground clearance is stated as 208 mm, though it can vary by variant. I’m not sure from the material I have whether it will scrape over large speed breakers when fully loaded with five people, so I won’t guess—best to check that with a test drive on your usual roads.

visual.description: Left side profile view of Tata Nexon

faq.question: What does the standard manufacturer warranty cover in terms of years and kilometres?
faq.answer: Tata advertises a basic warranty of three years and one lakh kilometres. The supplied brochure doesn't explain which limit applies first or the exclusions, so please confirm the full warranty terms.

faq.question: Does this Fearless + PS trim include both front-seat ventilation and rear AC vents?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented Fearless + PS petrol and diesel versions include ventilated driver and co-driver seats, along with rear AC vents.

visual.description: Interior detail showing ventilated front seats

faq.question: How large is the central infotainment touchscreen and the driver's digital instrument display?
faq.answer: In the documented petrol and diesel range, Pure + and higher have a 26.03 cm HARMAN touchscreen. Fearless + PS also has a 26.03 cm digital driver display.

visual.description: Dashboard view from front interior showing digital cluster, steering wheel, and infotainment screen

faq.question: What is the capacity of the fuel tank on the petrol variant versus the cylinders on the iCNG model?
faq.answer: The petrol Nexon comes with a fuel tank capacity of 44 litres. On the iCNG variant, it features a twin-cylinder setup with a total capacity of 60 litres, arranged as two 30-litre cylinders.

faq.question: Is the iRA connected car app included free permanently, or does it require a paid subscription after a trial?
faq.answer: It is not free permanently. On the Fearless + PS petrol and diesel variants, the first-year iRA app subscription is free, and renewal charges apply after that.

faq.question: Are there any active ADAS features included on this top-spec model?
faq.answer: Yes, on the Fearless + PS petrol DCA, you get features like Front Collision Warning, Autonomous Emergency Braking, Lane Centering System, and Lane Keep Assist, alongside Traffic Sign Recognition, Lane Departure Warning, and High Beam Assist. Please note that this ADAS suite is exclusive to the petrol automatic and is not available on diesel or CNG versions.

lines.text: Let's explore the Nexon Fearless Plus P S petrol automatic.
We'll look at the cabin, family details and driving choices. You can steer the tour toward what matters to you.

deeper.text: The brochure lists a length of 3,995 millimetres and a wheelbase of 2,498 millimetres.
A personal visit is the place to check your driving position and the space around your passengers.

callouts.text: Six airbags and stability control: standard

lines.text: Three things to explore: front-seat ventilation, a seven-speed automatic, and standard safety equipment.
We'll put each alongside what you need from your next car.

deeper.text: This Fearless Plus P S petrol automatic has ventilated front seats; rear air vents begin at Pure Plus in the petrol and diesel range.
Six airbags, electronic stability control and ISOFIX are standard equipment.

lines.text: Take in the side profile.
Tata lists 208 millimetres of ground clearance, with variation by trim. Keep that figure alongside the roads and parking spaces you use.

deeper.text: The brochure lists a width of 1,804 millimetres and a height of 1,620 millimetres. Check the dimensions against your parking space.
Smart and Pure use 195/60 R16 tyres; Creative and Fearless use 215/60 R16.

checkin.text: Does that cover what you wanted to know about the exterior?

callouts.text: Pure+ upwards, petrol/diesel: rear air vents

lines.text: In this Fearless Plus P S petrol automatic, both front seats are ventilated, and rear passengers have their own air vents.
Try both rows when you visit.

deeper.text: Front-seat ventilation is listed for Fearless Plus P S in the petrol and diesel trim list. It isn't rear-seat ventilation.
Rear air vents begin at Pure Plus and continue through the higher petrol and diesel trims.

checkin.text: How does that fit what you want from the cabin?

slides.image_reason: the script's own picture, and its parts match
slides.title: Room for your plans

callouts.text: Petrol/diesel: 382L boot, measured to ISO V215

lines.text: Here's the boot. Petrol and diesel versions are listed at 382 litres, measured to ISO V215.
For a stroller or weekend bags, bring your own and check the fit with the seats in use.

deeper.text: The CNG boot is listed at 321 litres using the same ISO V215 measurement basis. Capacity alone won't settle the fit of your luggage.
Creative Plus P S and Fearless Plus P S petrol and diesel trims have sixty-forty flip-and-fold rear seats, plus a rear armrest with a cup holder.

checkin.text: Does that help with the luggage checks you want to make?

slides.image_reason: hero — no picture matches this topic
slides.title: Find your driving rhythm

lines.text: This Fearless Plus P S pairs the turbo petrol engine with a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic.
For stop-and-go driving, try its response on a test drive and see how it feels to you.

deeper.text: The 1.2-litre turbo petrol is listed at 88.2 kilowatts at 5,500 rpm, with 170 newton-metres at 1,750 to 4,000 rpm.
The diesel has manual and automated-manual options. CNG uses a six-speed manual; the seven-speed dual-clutch automatic is a petrol option, with availability depending on trim.

checkin.text: Is an automatic the direction you're leaning towards?

slides.image_reason: hero — no picture matches this topic
slides.title: Safety starts with the details

callouts.text: Six airbags and stability control: standard

lines.text: Six airbags, electronic stability control and ISOFIX are standard equipment.
Tata reports a five-star Bharat NCAP rating for petrol and diesel trims active in May 2026. Extra driver-assistance features depend on the trim.

deeper.text: For your child seat, ISOFIX is a useful starting point. Check the seat's compatibility and installation instructions before fitting it.
On this Fearless Plus P S petrol automatic, the listed driver assists include autonomous emergency braking and lane keep assist.

checkin.text: Does that cover your main safety concerns?

callouts.text: Fearless+PS petrol DCA: JBL audio with subwoofer

lines.text: Take a closer look at the cockpit: this Fearless Plus P S has a 26.03-centimetre touchscreen and a matching-size driver display.
On the petrol automatic, JBL audio with a subwoofer is another detail to try.

deeper.text: The 26.03-centimetre touchscreen begins at Pure Plus. The same-size driver display is listed on Fearless Plus P S in the petrol and diesel range.
Creative adds the surround-view camera and blind-view monitor; front parking sensors start at Creative Plus P S in the petrol and diesel range.

checkin.text: Does that cover the cockpit features you wanted to see?

slides.title: Make the next step count

callouts.text: From ₹7.39 lakh ex-showroom; prices may change

lines.text: For the buying decision, get a current on-road quote for your exact variant.
Tata advertises a three-year, 100,000-kilometre warranty headline. Read the full written coverage and exclusions before deciding.

deeper.text: The advertised starting price is 7.39 lakh rupees ex-showroom, subject to change. It isn't a quote for this Fearless Plus P S automatic.
For selected variants, Flexi EMI is advertised from 6,499 rupees for the first six months, with higher instalments later. Final EMI and finance remain at the financier's discretion.

lines.text: We've looked at the cabin, family equipment and petrol automatic. The next useful check is how the seats, visibility and gearbox feel to you.
Choose Book Test Drive when you're ready, or stay here and ask another question.

brand.tone: Bold, tech-forward, reassuring, and distinctly focused on modern safety and progressive engineering.
brand.voice_style: Speak with confident warmth, articulate clarity, and strict adherence to verified specifications without hyperbole.
dos: Explicitly highlight standard safety features such as 6 airbags and ESP across all trims
Accurately state engine configurations and transmission pairings with exact units
Clearly explain trim-level dependencies for premium features like ADAS and ventilated seats
donts: Do not make unverified claims about real-world fuel economy or water wading depth
Do not infer warranty terms, exclusions, or whichever-comes-first rules beyond the printed 3-year / 100,000 km badge
Do not generalize ADAS or DCA transmission availability to diesel or iCNG models
brand.persona_hint: An authoritative, courteous Tata Motors product specialist who presents accurate technical specifications and transparent commercial conditions.
